Then they ſhallshall be left to fall, as they are inclined by their own Weightweight. GOD won't hold them up in theſethese ſlipperyslippery Placesplaces any longer, but will let them go; and then, at that very Inſtantinstant, they ſhallshall fall into Deſtructiondestruction; as he that ſtandsstands in ſuchsuch ſlipperyslippery declining Groundground on the Edgeedge of a Pitpit that he can't ſtandstand alone, when he is let go, he immediately falls and is loſtlost.

The Obſervationobservation from the Wordswords that I would now inſiſtinsist upon, is this, Therethere is Nothingnothing that keeps wicked Menmen, at any one Momentmoment, out of Hellhell, but the meer Pleaſurepleasure of GOD.

By the meer Pleaſurepleasure of GOD, I mean his ſovereignsovereign Pleaſurepleasure, his arbitrary Willwill, reſtrainedrestrained by no Obligationobligation, hinder'd by no Mannermanner of Difficultydifficulty, any more than if nothing elſeelse but GOD'sGod's meer Willwill had in the leaſtleast Degreedegree, or in any Reſpectrespect whatſoeverwhatsoever, any Handhand in the PreſervationPreservation of wicked Menmen one Momentmoment.
The Truthtruth of this Obſervationobservation may appear by the following Conſiderationsconsiderations.

1. There is no Wantwant of Powerpower in GOD to caſtcast wicked Menmen into Hellhell at any Momentmoment. Men's Handshands can't be ſtrongstrong when GOD riſesrises up: Thethe ſtrongeſtstrongest have no Powerpower to reſiſtresist him, nor can any deliver out of his Handshands.

He is not only able to caſtcast wicked Menmen into Hellhell, but he can moſtmost eaſilyeasily do it. Sometimes an earthly Princeprince meets with a great deal of Difficultydifficulty to ſubduesubdue a Rebel, that has found Meansmeans to fortify himſelfhimself, and has made himſelfhimself ſtrongstrong by the Numbersnumbers of his Followersfollowers. But it is not ſoso with GOD. There is no FortreſsFortress that is any Defencedefence from the Powerpower of GOD. Tho' Handhand join in Handhand, and vaſtvast Multitudesmultitudes of GOD'sGod's Enemiesenemies combine and aſſociateassociate themſelvesthemselves, they are eaſilyeasily broken in Pieces: Theythey are as great Heaps of light
Chaffchaff before the Whirlwind; or large Quantities of dry Stubble before devouring Flamesflames. We find it eaſyeasy to tread on, and cruſhcrush a Worm, that we ſeesee crawling on the Earthearth; ſoso 'tis eaſyeasy for us to cut or ſingesinge a ſlenderslender Threadthread that any Thingsthings hangs by; thus eaſyeasy is it for GOD, when he pleaſespleases, to caſtcast his Enemiesenemies down to Hellhell. What are we, that we ſhouldshould think to ſtandstand before him, at whoſewhose Rebuke the Earthearth trembles, and before whom the Rocksrocks are thrown down?

2. They deſervedeserve to be caſtcast into Hellhell; ſoso that divine Juſticejustice never ſtandsstands in the Wayway, it makes no Objectionobjection againſtagainst GOD'sGod's uſingusing his Powerpower at any Momentmoment to deſtroydestroy them. Yea, on the contrary, Juſticejustice calls aloud for an infinite Puniſhmentpunishment of their Sinssins. Divine Juſticejustice, ſayssays of the Treetree that brings forth ſuchsuch Grapesgrapes of Sodom, Cut it down, why cumbreth it the Groundground, Luk. xiiiXiii. 7. The Swordsword of divine Juſticejustice is every Momentmoment brandiſhedbrandished over their Headsheads, and 'tis nothing but the Handhand of arbitrary Mercymercy, and GOD'sGod's meer Willwill, that holds it back.

3. They are already under a Sentencesentence of Condemnationcondemnation to Hellhell. They don't only juſtlyjustly deſervedeserve to be caſtcast down thither; but the Sentencesentence of the Lawlaw of GOD, that eternal and immutable Rulerule of Righteouſneſsrighteousness, that GOD has fixed between him and Mankindmankind, is gone out againſtagainst them, and ſtandsstands againſtagainst them; ſoso that they are bound over already to Hellhell. John iii. 18. He that believeth not is condemned already. So that every unconverted Manman properly belongs to Hellhell; that is his Placeplace; from thence he is. John viii. 23. Ye are from beneath: Andand thither he is bound; 'tis the Placeplace that Juſticejustice, and GOD'sGod's Wordword, and the Sentencesentence of his unchangeable Lawlaw aſſignsassigns to him.

4. They are now the Objectsobjects of that very ſamesame Angeranger and Wrathwrath of GOD, that is expreſſedexpressed in the Tormentstorments of Hellhell▪ Andand the Reaſonreason why they don't go down to Hellhell at each Momentmoment, is not becauſebecause GOD, in whoſewhose Powerpower they are, is not then very angry with them; as angry as he is with many of thoſethose miſerablemiserable Creaturescreatures, that he is now tormenting in Hellhell, and do there feel and bear the Fierceneſsfierceness of his Wrathwrath. Yea, GOD is a great deal more angry with great Numbersnumbers that are now on Earthearth; yea, doubtleſsdoubtless, with many that are
now in this Congregationcongregation, that it may be, are at Eaſeease and Quiet, than he is with many of thoſethose that are now in the Flamesflames of Hellhell.

So that it is not becauſebecause GOD is unmindful of their Wickedneſswickedness, and don't reſentresent it, that he don't let looſeloose his Handhand and cut them off. GOD is not altogether ſuchsuch an Oneone as themſelvesthemselves, tho' they may imagine him to be ſoso. The Wrathwrath of GOD burns againſtagainst them, their Damnationdamnation don't ſlumberslumber, the Pitpit is prepared, the Firefire is made ready, the Furnacefurnace is now hot, ready to receive them; the Flamesflames do now rage and glow. The glittering Swordsword is whet, and held over them, and the Pitpit hath opened her Mouthmouth under them.

5. The Devildevil ſtandsstands ready to fall upon them, and ſeizeseize them as his own, at what Momentmoment GOD ſhallshall permit him. They belong to him; he has their Soulssouls in his Poſſeſſionpossession, and under his Dominiondominion. The Scripture repreſentsrepresents them as his Goodsgoods, Luk. xiXi. 12. The Devilsdevils watch them; they are ever by them, at their right Handhand; they ſtandstand waiting for them, like greedy hungry Lionslions that ſeesee their Preyprey, and expect to have it, but are for the Preſentpresent kept back; if GOD ſhouldshould withdraw his Handhand, by which they are reſtrainedrestrained, they would in one Momentmoment fly upon their poor Soulssouls. The old Serpentserpent is gaping for them; Hellhell opens its Mouthmouth wide to receive them; and if God ſhouldshould permit it, they would be haſtilyhastily ſwallowedswallowed up and loſtlost.

6. There are in the Soulssouls of wicked Menmen, thoſethose helliſhhellish Principlesprinciples reigning, that would preſentlypresently kindle and flame out into Hellhell Firefire, if it were not for GOD'sGod's Reſtraintsrestraints. There is laid in the very Naturenature of carnal Menmen, a Foundationfoundation for the Tormentstorments of Hellhell: Therethere are thoſethose currupt Principlesprinciples, in reigning Powerpower in them, and in full Poſſeſſionpossession of them, that are Seedsseeds of Hellhell Firefire. TheſeThese Principlesprinciples are active and powerful, exceeding violent in their Naturenature, and if it were not for the reſtrainingrestraining Handhand of GOD upon them, they would ſoonsoon break out, they would flame out after the ſamesame Mannermanner as the ſamesame Corruptionscorruptions, the ſamesame Enmityenmity does in the Heartshearts of damned Soulssouls, and would beget the ſamesame Tormentstorments in 'em as they do in them. The Soulssouls of the Wickedwicked, are in Scripture compared to the troubled Sea, IſaiIsai. lviiLvii. 20. For
the preſentpresent GOD reſtrainsrestrains their Wickedneſswickedness by his mighty Powerpower, as he does the raging Waveswaves of the troubled Sea, ſayingsaying, Hitherto ſhaltshalt thou come, and no further; but if GOD ſhouldshould withdraw that reſtrainingrestraining Powerpower, it would ſoonsoon carry all afore it. Sin is the Ruinruin and Miſerymisery of the Soulsoul; it is deſtructivedestructive in it's Naturenature; and if GOD ſhouldshould leave it without Reſtraintrestraint, there would need nothing elſeelse to make the Soulsoul perfectly miſerablemiserable. The Corruptioncorruption of the Heartheart of Manman is a Thingthing that is immoderate and boundleſsboundless in its Fury; and while wicked Menmen live here, it is like Firefire pent up by GOD'sGod's Reſtraintsrestraints, whenas if it were let looſeloose, it would ſetset on Firefire the Courſecourse of Naturenature; and as the Heartheart is now a Sinksink of Sinsin, ſoso, if Sinsin was not reſtrain'drestrain'd, it would immediately turn the Soulsoul into a fiery Ovenoven, or a Furnacefurnace of Firefire and BrimſtoneBrimstone.

7. It is no Securitysecurity to wicked Menmen for one Momentmoment, that there are no viſiblevisible Meansmeans of Deathdeath at Handhand. 'Tis no Securitysecurity to a natural Manman, that he is now in Healthhealth, and that he don't ſeesee which Wayway he ſhouldshould now immediately go out of the Worldworld by any Accident, and that there is no viſiblevisible Dangerdanger in any Reſpectrespect in his Circumſtancescircumstances. The manifold and continual Experienceexperience of the Worldworld in all Agesages, ſhewsshows that this is no Evidenceevidence that a Manman is not on the very Brinkbrink of Eternityeternity, and that the next Stepstep won't be into another Worldworld. The unſeenunseen, unthought-of Waysways and Meansmeans of Perſonspersons going ſuddenlysuddenly out of the Worldworld are innumerable and inconceivable. Unconverted Menmen walk over the Pitpit of Hellhell on a rotten Covering, and there are innumerable Placesplaces in this Covering ſoso weak that they won't bear their Weightweight, and theſethese Placesplaces are not ſeenseen. The Arrows of Deathdeath fly unſeenunseen at Noonnoon-Dayday; the ſharpeſtsharpest Sightsight can't diſcerndiscern them▪ GOD has ſoso many different unſearchableunsearchable Waysways of taking Wickedwicked Menmen out of the Worldworld and ſendingsending 'em to Hellhell, that there is nothing to make it appear, that GOD had need to be at the Expence of a Miraclemiracle, or go out of the ordinary Courſecourse of his Providenceprovidence, to deſtroydestroy any wicked Manman, at any Momentmoment. All the Meansmeans that there are of Sinnerssinners going out of the Worldworld, are ſoso in GOD'sGod's Handshands, and ſoso univerſallyuniversally abſolutelyabsolutely ſubjectsubject to his Powerpower
and Determinationdetermination, that it don't depend at all leſsless on the meer Willwill of GOD, whether Sinnerssinners ſhallshall at any Momentmoment go to Hellhell, than if Meansmeans were never made uſeuse of, or at all concerned in the Caſecase.

8. Natural Men'smen's Prudence and Carecare to preſervepreserve their own Liveslives, or the Carecare of others to preſervepreserve them, don't ſecuresecure 'em a Momentmoment. This divine Providenceprovidence and univerſaluniversal Experienceexperience does alſoalso bear Teſtimonytestimony to. There is this clear Evidenceevidence that Men'smen's own Wiſdomwisdom is no Securitysecurity to them from Deathdeath; Thatthat if it were otherwiſeotherwise we ſhouldshould ſeesee ſomesome Differencedifference between the wiſewise and politick Menmen of the Worldworld, and others, with Regardregard to their LiableneſsLiableness to early and unexpected Deathdeath; but how is it in Factfact? EcleſEcles. 2. 16. How dieth the wiſewise Manman? asAs the Foolfool.

9. All wicked Men'smen's Painspains and Contrivancecontrivance they uſeuse to eſcapeescape Hellhell, while they continue to reject CHRIST, and ſoso remain wicked Menmen, don't ſecuresecure 'em from Hellhell one Momentmoment. AlmoſtAlmost every natural Manman that hears of Hellhell, flatters himſelfhimself that he ſhallshall eſcapeescape it; he depends upon himſelfhimself for his own Securitysecurity; he flatters himſelfhimself in what he has done, and in what he is now doing, or what he intends to do; every one lays out Mattersmatters in his own Mindmind how he ſhallshall avoid Damnationdamnation, and flatters himſelfhimself that he contrives well for himſelfhimself, and that his Schemesschemes won't fail. They hear indeed that there are but few ſavedsaved, and that the bigger Partpart of Menmen that have died heretofore are gone to Hellhell; but each one imagines that he lays out Mattersmatters better for his own Eſcapeescape than others have done: Hehe don't intend to come to that Placeplace of Tormenttorment; he ſayssays within himſelfhimself, that he intends to take Carecare that ſhallshall be effectual, and to order Mattersmatters ſoso for himſelfhimself as not to fail.

But the fooliſhfoolish Childrenchildren of Menmen do miſerablymiserably delude themſelvesthemselves in their own Schemesschemes, and in their Confidenceconfidence in their own Strengthstrength and Wiſdomwisdom; they truſttrust to nothing but a Shadowshadow. The bigger Partpart of thoſethose that heretofore have lived under the ſamesame Meansmeans of Gracegrace, and are now dead, are undoubtedly gone to Hellhell; and it was not becauſebecause they were not as wiſewise as thoſethose that are now alive; it was not becauſebecause they did not lay out Mattersmatters as well for themſelvesthemselves to
ſecuresecure their own Eſcapeescape. If it were ſoso, that we could come to ſpeakspeak with them, and could enquire of them, one by one, whether they expected when alive, and when they uſedused to hear about Hellhell, ever to be the Subjectssubjects of that Miſerymisery, we doubtleſsdoubtless ſhouldshould hear one and another reply, Nono, I never intended to come here; I had laid out Mattersmatters otherwiſeotherwise in my Mindmind; I thought I ſhouldshould contrive well for my ſelfself; I thought my Schemescheme good; I intended to take effectual Carecare; but it came upon me unexpected; I did not look for it at that Timetime, and in that Mannermanner; it came as a Thiefthief; Deathdeath outwitted me; GOD'sGod's Wrathwrath was too quick for me; O my curſedcursed Fooliſhneſsfoolishness! I was flattering myſelfmyself, and pleaſingpleasing myſelfmyself with vain Dreamsdreams of what I would do hereafter, and when I was ſayingsaying Peacepeace and Safetysafety, then ſuddensudden Deſtructiondestruction came upon me.

10. GOD has laid himſelfhimself under no Obligationobligation, by any Promiſepromise, to keep any natural Manman out of Hellhell one Momentmoment. GOD certainly has made no Promiſespromises either of eternal Lifelife, or of any Deliverancedeliverance or PreſervationPreservation from eternal Deathdeath, but what are contained in the Covenantcovenant of Gracegrace, the Promiſespromises that are given in CHRIST, in whom all the Promiſespromises are Yeayea and Amen. But ſurelysurely they have no Intereſtinterest in the Promiſespromises of the Covenantcovenant of Gracegrace, that are not the Childrenchildren of the Covenantcovenant, and that don't believe in any of the Promiſespromises of the Covenantcovenant, and have no Intereſtinterest in the Mediator of the Covenantcovenant.

So that whatever ſomesome have imagined and pretended about Promiſespromises made to natural Men'smen's earneſtearnest ſeekingseeking and knocking, 'tis plain and manifeſtmanifest, that whatever Painspains a natural Manman takes in Religionreligion, whatever Prayersprayers he makes, till he believes in CHRIST, GOD is under no manner of Obligationobligation to keep him a Momentmoment from eternal Deſtructiondestruction.

So that thus it is, that natural Menmen are held in the Handhand of GOD over the Pitpit of Hellhell; they have deſerveddeserved the fiery Pitpit, and are already ſentencedsentenced to it; and GOD is dreadfully provoked, his Angeranger is as great towards them as to thoſethose that are actually ſufferingsuffering the Executions of the Fierceneſsfierceness of his Wrathwrath in Hellhell, and they have done nothing in the
leaſtleast, to appeaſeappease or abate that Angeranger, neither is GOD in the leaſtleast bound by any Promiſepromise to hold 'em up one Momentmoment; the Devildevil is waiting for them, Hellhell is gaping for them, the Flamesflames gather and flaſhflash about them, and would fain lay hold on them, and ſwallowswallow them up; the Firefire pent up in their own Heartshearts is ſtrugglingstruggling to break out; and they have no Intereſtinterest in any Mediator, there are no Meansmeans within Reachreach that can be any Securitysecurity to them. In ſhortshort, they have no Refugerefuge, nothing to take hold of, all that preſervespreserves them every Momentmoment is the meer arbitrary Willwill, and uncovenanted unobliged Forbearance of an incenſedincensed GOD.

div.head: APPLICATION.
div.p: The USEuse may be of Awakeningawakening to unconverted Perſonspersons in this Congregationcongregation. This that you have heard is the Caſecase of every one of you that are out of ChriſtChrist. That Worldworld of Miſerymisery, that Lake of burning BrimſtoneBrimstone is extended abroad under you. There is the dreadful Pitpit of the glowing Flamesflames of the Wrathwrath of GOD; there is Hell's wide gaping Mouthmouth open; and you have nothing to ſtandstand upon, nor any Thingthing to take hold of: there is nothing between you and Hellhell but the Airair; 'tis only the Powerpower and meer Pleaſurepleasure of GOD that holds you up.

You probably are not ſenſiblesensible of this; you find you are kept out of Hellhell, but don't ſeesee the Handhand of GOD in it, but look at other Thingsthings, as the good Statestate of your bodily Conſtitutionconstitution, your Carecare of your own Lifelife, and the Meansmeans you uſeuse for your own PreſervationPreservation. But indeed theſethese Thingsthings are nothing; if GOD ſhouldshould withdraw his Handhand, they would avail no more to keep you from falling, than the thin Airair to hold up a Perſonperson that is ſuſpendedsuspended in it.

Your Wickedneſswickedness makes you as it were heavy as Loadload, and to tend downwards with great Weightweight and Preſſurepressure towards Hellhell; and if GOD ſhouldshould let you go, you would immediately ſinksink and ſwiftlyswiftly deſcenddescend and plunge into the bottomleſsbottomless Gulf, and your healthy Conſtitutionconstitution, and your own Carecare and Prudence, and beſtbest Contrivancecontrivance, and all your Righteouſneſsrighteousness, would have no more Influenceinfluence to uphold you and keep you out of Hellhell, then a Spider's Web would have to ſtopstop a falling Rockrock. Were it not, that ſoso is the
ſovereignsovereign Pleaſurepleasure of GOD, the Earthearth would not bear you one Momentmoment; for you are a Burdenburden to it; the Creationcreation groans with you; the Creaturecreature is made ſubjectsubject to the Bondagebondage of your Corruptioncorruption, not willingly; the Sunsun don't willingly ſhineshine upon you to give you Lightlight to ſerveserve Sinsin and Satan; the Earthearth don't willingly yield her Increaſeincrease to ſatisfysatisfy your Luſtslusts; nor is it willingly a Stage for your Wickedneſswickedness to be acted upon; the Airair don't willingly ſerveserve you for Breathbreath to maintain the Flameflame of Lifelife in your Vitalsvitals, while you ſpendspend your Lifelife in the Serviceservice of GOD'sGod's Enemiesenemies. GOD'sGod's Creaturescreatures are good, and were made for Menmen to ſerveserve GOD with, and don't willingly ſubſervesubserve to any other Purpoſepurpose, and groan when they are abuſedabused to Purpoſespurposes ſoso directly contrary to their Naturenature and Endend. And the Worldworld would ſpuespue you out, were it not for the ſovereignsovereign Handhand of him who hath ſubjectedsubjected it in Hopehope. There are the black Cloudsclouds of GOD'sGod's Wrathwrath now hanging directly over your Headsheads, full of the dreadful Storm, and big with Thunderthunder; and were it not for the reſtrainingrestraining Handhand of GOD, it would immediately burſtburst forth upon you. The ſovereignsovereign Pleaſurepleasure of GOD, for the preſentpresent, ſtaysstays his rough Windwind; otherwiſeotherwise it would come with Fury, and your Deſtructiondestruction would come like a Whirlwind, and you would be like the Chaffchaff of the Summersummer threſhingthreshing Floor.

The Wrathwrath of GOD is like great Waterswaters that are dammed for the Preſentpresent; they increaſeincrease more and more, and riſerise higher and higher, till an Outlet is given, and the longer the Streamstream is ſtop'dstop'd, the more rapid and mighty is it's Courſecourse, when once it is let looſeloose. 'Tis true, that Judgmentjudgment againſtagainst your evil Worksworks, has not been executed hitherto; the Floods of GOD'sGod's Vengeancevengeance have been with-held; but your Guiltguilt in the mean Timetime is conſtantlyconstantly increaſingincreasing, and you are every Dayday treaſuringtreasuring up more Wrathwrath; the Waterswaters are continually riſingrising, and waxing more and more mighty; and there is Nothingnothing but the meer Pleaſurepleasure of GOD, that holds the Waterswaters back, that are unwilling to be ſtoppedstopped, and preſspress hard to go forward; if GOD ſhouldshould only withdraw his Handhand from the Floodflood-Gategate, it would immediately fly open, and the fiery Floods of the Fierceneſsfierceness and Wrathwrath of GOD, would ruſhrush forth with inconceivable Fury, and would come upon
you with omnipotent Powerpower; and if your Strengthstrength were ten Thouſandthousand Timestimes greater than it is, yea, ten thouſandthousand Timestimes greater than the Strengthstrength of the ſtouteſtstoutest, ſturdieſtsturdiest Devildevil in Hellhell, it would be Nothingnothing to withſtandwithstand or endure it.

The Bowbow of GOD'sGod's Wrathwrath is bent, and the Arrow made ready on the String, and Juſticejustice bends the Arrow at your Heartheart, and ſtrainsstrains the Bowbow, and it is Nothingnothing but the meer Pleaſurepleasure of GOD, and that of an angry GOD, without any Promiſepromise or Obligationobligation at all, that keeps the Arrow one Momentmoment from being made drunk with your Bloodblood.

Thus are all you that never paſſedpassed under a great Changechange of Heartheart, by the mighty Powerpower of the SPIRIT of GOD upon your Soulssouls; all that were never born again, and made new Creaturescreatures, and raiſedraised from being dead in Sinsin, to a Statestate of new, and before altogether unexperienced Lightlight and Lifelife, (however you may have reformed your Lifelife in many Thingsthings, and may have had religious Affectionsaffections, and may keep up a Formform of Religionreligion in your Familiesfamilies and CloſetsClosets, and in the Houſeshouses of GOD, and may be ſtrictstrict in it,) you are thus in the Handshands of an angry GOD; 'tis Nothingnothing but his meer Pleaſurepleasure, that keeps you from being this Momentmoment ſwallowedswallowed up in everlaſtingeverlasting Deſtructiondestruction.

However unconvinced you may now be of the Truthtruth of what you hear, by and by you will be fully convinced of it. ThoſeThose that are gone from being in the like Circumſtancescircumstances with you, ſeesee that it was ſoso with them; for Deſtructiondestruction came ſuddenlysuddenly upon moſtmost of them, when they expected Nothingnothing of it, and while they were ſayingsaying, Peacepeace and Safetysafety: Nownow they ſeesee, that thoſethose Thingsthings that they depended on for Peacepeace and Safetysafety, were Nothingnothing but thin Airair and empty Shadowsshadows.

The GOD that holds you over the Pitpit of Hellhell, much as one holds a Spider, or ſomesome loathſomeloathsome Infect, over the Firefire, abhors you, and is dreadfully provoked; his Wrathwrath towards you burns like Firefire; he looks upon you as worthy of Nothingnothing elſeelse, but to be caſtcast into the Firefire; he is of purer Eyeseyes than to bear to have you in his Sightsight; you are ten thouſandthousand Timestimes ſoso abominable in his Eyeseyes, as the moſtmost hateful venomous Serpentserpent is in ours. You have offended him infinitely more than ever a ſtubbornstubborn Rebel did his Princeprince: Andand yet,
'tis Nothingnothing but his Handhand that holds you from falling into the Firefire every Momentmoment: 'Tis'tis to be aſcribedascribed to Nothingnothing elſeelse, that you did not go to Hellhell the laſtlast Nightnight; that you was ſuffer'dsuffer'd to awake again in this Worldworld, after you cloſedclosed your Eyeseyes to ſleepsleep: Andand there is no other Reaſonreason to be given, why you have not dropped into Hellhell ſincesince you aroſearose in the Morningmorning, but that GOD'sGod's Handhand has held you up: Therethere is no other Reaſonreason to be given why you han't gone to Hellhell, ſincesince you have ſatsat here in the Houſehouse of GOD, provoking his pure Eyeseyes by your ſinfulsinful wicked Mannermanner of attending his ſolemnsolemn Worſhipworship: Yeayea, there is Nothingnothing elſeelse that is to be given as a Reaſonreason why you don't this very Momentmoment drop down into Hellhell.

O Sinnersinner! ConſiderConsider the fearful Dangerdanger you are in: 'Tis'tis a great Furnacefurnace of Wrathwrath, a wide and bottomleſsbottomless Pitpit, full of the Firefire of Wrathwrath, that you are held over in the Handhand of that GOD, whoſewhose Wrathwrath is provoked and incenſedincensed as much againſtagainst you, as againſtagainst many of the Damned in Hellhell: Youyou hang by a ſlenderslender Threadthread, with the Flamesflames of divine Wrathwrath flaſhingflashing about it, and ready every Momentmoment to ſingesinge it, and burn it aſunderasunder; and you have no Intereſtinterest in any Mediator, and Nothingnothing to lay hold of to ſavesave yourſelfyourself, Nothingnothing to keep off the Flamesflames of Wrathwrath, Nothingnothing of your own, Nothingnothing that you ever have done, Nothingnothing that you can do, to induce GOD to ſparespare you one Momentmoment.
And conſiderconsider he • e more particularly ſeveralseveral Thingsthings concerning that Wrathwrath that you are in ſuchsuch Dangerdanger of.

1. WhoſeWhose Wrathwrath it is: Itit is the Wrathwrath of the infinite GOD.
